title: I my demo at steam not doing good. I need some feedbacks!!!
author: No_Ant6295
selftext:
I came here few weeks ago and posted my progress. Now I have a steam page and a demo.   
It's a top down extraction zombie game where you get to build own shelter and recruit npcs.  
Currently demo is not doing very good and was hoping to get some feedback from you guys

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5006540/Dead\_Extraction?utm\_source=red](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5006540/Dead_Extraction?utm_source=red)

comments.author: NothingBrgr
comments.body: Haven't tried yet but my first(and strong) impression is that it is hard to figure out what the game is all about. Having many mechanic is fine but I think their should be some major concept that envelopes the whole concept, and that is where the players usually immerse themselves in. I can see it is Zombie-themed, but gameplay wise it is very hard to say what is the core.

replies.author: No_Ant6295
replies.body: will change my next to trailer to more zombie focused gameplay trailer

comments.author: RuinousFate
comments.body: Bro the bullets are coming from people's feet, not gun muzzle

replies.author: RuinousFate
replies.body: Yeah the problem is your trailer uses that. That's a major turn off

replies.author: don_mumrik
replies.body: How do you not see this as problematic by your own accord?

comments.author: Lordxb
comments.body: You need to fix your modals to have the 9 way turn direction and also match that with the gun muzzle fire!!

replies.author: No_Ant6295
replies.body:
I have like 50+ creatures/human models I can't afford to do make 8direction sprites for all 50+ creatures  
you think 8directions for only main character will work?

replies.author: Lordxb
replies.body: You got 2 options 8 directions or modify your game to be side scrolling only!!

replies.author: throwawaybrisbent
replies.body:
If all parts of the game are by AI and you want people to want to play it, it's going to cost you more. 

You can't cheapout on visuals and then dismiss feedback on your visuals.

replies.author: No_Ant6295
replies.body: was actually wanting feedback on demo gameplay but apparently that doesn't seem like the problem

comments.author: Nryquellts
comments.body: I think there's a lot of good in here, but you need to scale it down and focus on a few systems that complement each other but if you do that and spend time brainstorming, I think you could make it something people would talk about.

comments.author: daddywookie
comments.body:
Holy scope creep Batman! I thought this was a demo for a humble bundle, not a single game.

Wind it way back, focus on quality. AI enables you to do lots of things but it doesn’t have much of a critical eye. You need to be the final judge of “good enough” and be really hard with yourself and the AI. Animation quality, game feel, precision and comprehension are skills you need to use and you can’t rely on the AI.

There’s a joke about game dev that the second 80% is the hardest. You think you are done and there is only polishing to go but that polish takes a ridiculous amount of effort.

replies.author: No_Ant6295
replies.body: will make properly zombie focused trailer next time

replies.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
replies.body: Be respectul to others and follow reddits guidelines and policies.

comments.author: DjangoDarkblade77
comments.body: good ideas, shitty execution. bullets everywhere, lack of visual consistency, characters moving weird. Just look, some of the vehicles are in side view while others are in top view, it sucks. The idea is great and it could absolutely work, it just need way more work.

replies.author: No_Ant6295
replies.body: OK I'll fix the cars and work on consistency

comments.author: rapkannibale
comments.body: For me I just don’t know what this game is about looking at the trailer. There is so much stuff and then like completely different things like what is the part where the level is just like white tiles and the part with the boulders and there is base building? Figure out what the main thing is for your game, look at similar games on Steam that have done well and what they show in the trailer and do that. Also if you set is AI you will immediately turn off a lot of Steam players so you need to make sure it is the best possible AI art. Using an asset pack is probably better than AI art just from a marketing point of view. Good luck!

comments.author: DocHolidayPhD
comments.body: It looks poorly animated, appears to have careless design/lacks polishing, and seems to play too simplistic, almost like it's busy-work to "play" the game. Where it seems more complex (where a bunch of UI menus pop up, it gives a feeling that this was thoughtlessly put together in that I now become overwhelmed by UI bloat. That's the vibe I get when I watched your trailer, anyways.
